options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: days_to_indicate_expiration_in_admin_view
options.displayName: Days To Indicate Expiration In Admin View
options.description: Number of days in advanced to show 'about to expire' indication in administrator view. Valid values are between 1 and 99.

options.name: days_to_notify_expiration_to_admin
options.displayName: Days To Notify Expiration To Admin
options.description: Number of days in advanced to notify administrator about expiration. Valid values are between 1 and 99.

options.name: expiration_date
options.description: Expiration date for new administrator in YYYY-MM-DD format. <font color="red">Required only when</font> 'expiration-type' is set to 'expiration date'.

options.name: expiration_period
options.description: Expiration period for new administrator. <font color="red">Required only when</font> 'expiration-type' is set to 'expiration period'. Valid values are between 1 and 99.

options.name: expiration_period_time_units
options.description: Expiration period time units for new administrator. <font color="red">Required only when</font> 'expiration-type' is set to 'expiration period'.

options.name: indicate_expiration_in_admin_view
options.description: Indicates whether to notify administrator about expiration.

options.name: notify_expiration_to_admin
options.description: Indicates whether to show 'about to expire' indication in administrator view.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
